lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7-8 distinct white vertical lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is generally uniform with a slight increase in lateral distance between the 4th and 5th segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first line segment proximal to the shoulder and the final segment on the posterior haunch are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the dorsal or ventral boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density grouping; one primary high-contrast circular spot located on the posterior mid-haunch, with two smaller, lower-contrast spots visible on the upper hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horn silhouette projects at a posterior-superior vector from the cranial base with a slight inward curvature, though resolution is low.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking visible on the snout; white transverse patch on the lower throat; high-contrast white distal limb markings (stockings) present on all visible legs.
